title: Calculator Screen Block
keywords: Mounted energy display for the adjacent face of an FE-compatible block

blocks.text: Mounted energy display for the adjacent face of an FE-compatible block.

rows: Use the Calculator Screen item on a horizontal face of an energy block.
Read that face’s stored energy and capacity.
Recheck the target capability when rotating or replacing the block.

blocks.text: This is a display, not a battery, converter or power cable.
